newsitem.title: USA: Teleport seeks Illinois telephone approval.
newsitem.headline: Teleport seeks Illinois telephone approval.

text.p: Teleport Communications Group Inc said Wednesday it filed an application with the Illinois Commerce Commission to offer telephone service in Illinois in the eastern St. Louis, Mo. metropolitan area.

The application requests the authority to compete in the "metro east" marketplace as a full service local exchange company for businesses that are increasingly dependent on telecommunications services, Teleport said.
A similar application was filed with the Public Service Commission of Missouri in April to provide local telephone service to the St. Louis, Mo. metropolitan area.

"We are in a unique situation where our metropolitan area extends into two states served by two different regional bell operating companies and state regulatory agencies," Bob Schmersahl, general manager of TCG St. Louis, said in a statement.

TCG St. Louis, which became operational in 1994, has a 160 route mile fiber optic network that extends throughout St. Louis as well as the counties of St. Louis and St. Charles in Missouri and East St. Louis in St. Clair County in Illinois.
